[USER] User expressed interest in the cascara latte and requested a simple recipe for it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for the Cascara Latte, including ingredients and instructions:  
- Ingredients: 1 teaspoon of cascara powder (or 2-3 whole dried cascara cherries), 1 cup of hot water (around 200°F to 205°F), 3-4 oz of milk (dairy or non-dairy), optional sweetener and spices.  
- Instructions: Steep cascara, strain, prepare milk, combine, and top with foam.
